commits.message:
docs(winter-test-service): reconcile README and verification docs with delete

Pre-push review flagged the README's Architecture prose as stale after the
delete feature (still described the api/web/service surface as
create-only), and the harness review flagged that the api/worker have no
auto-reload, which cost a debug cycle during this feature's own delivery.
Also tidies the verification script's out-of-order check labels and a
duplicated port literal.

feat(winter-test-service): allow deleting items

Adds DELETE /api/items/{id} through the existing repository seam (204 on
success, 404 via a new ItemNotFoundError when the id doesn't exist), and a
delete control on every row in the web UI that removes the row locally
without a full page reload. Also records a runtime verification method
(scripts/verify_item_api.sh + context/testing/verifiability-matrix.md) since
this repo has no automated test suite.
